root_selected_source_scope.scope: Only original Theorem 1.3 in characteristics p=2,3 is selected; its entire original all-prime statement is retained as context, without changing its quantifiers, and the already known p>=5 result is not another unit. Definitions 1.1/1.2, all selected Sections 2--5, complete non-classical integration, both characteristic-specific symmetrization chains and the full quantitative closing proof are printed. Precise named ordinary prerequisites are Tao--Ziegler [18, Lemma 1.7(iii), Lemma 4.5, Eq. (4.1), Lemma B.1(iv)] polynomial normal form/classical integration/Gowers--Cauchy--Schwarz; Lovett [12, Theorem 1.5] analytic-rank subadditivity; Janzer [11] and Milicevic [15] polynomial analytic/partition-rank comparison as Theorem 2.3; Gowers--Milicevic [5, beginning of Section 10] initial quantitative triaffine correlation as Theorem 5.1; and the terminal U3 inverse theorem explicitly invoked in the original proof. All locally new constructions and nested proofs remain editable. Original literal notation is preserved, including the n/k count at 352, the tensor-index/product punctuation at 287, the (-1) phase and transposition notation in Corollary 4.2, the source reference to classical integration for the quadratic phase at 585 and the source convention omega-to-P for non-classical phases. These are source notes, with no mathematical verdict or formula repair. Original indices and footnotes are restored; integration/symmetrization helpers count zero.
root_selected_source_scope.reason: Even after the precise quantitative triaffine-correlation theorem, polynomial normal form, analytic/partition rank comparison and terminal U3 inverse theorem, the author must integrate non-classical multilinear forms by a full coefficient classification and build characteristic-specific symmetry corrections. A new diagonal bilinear defect argument in characteristic two and controlled subspace extensions preserve quantitative rank losses. The final Fourier conditioning, quadratic corrections and eight-phase cube remove those defects with explicit losses, leaving a sustained nonroutine argument beyond ordinary qualification Fourier analysis; the complete selected outcome is conservatively H2.
